model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 7B Turbo 8-Step
model.description: Official Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo checkpoint: generation and multi-reference editing (up to 10 reference images) in 8 steps at CFG 1 with the checkpoint's own sigma schedule and the reference KV cache. Small requests render on a ~1.3 MP canvas of the same aspect ratio and are downscaled afterwards; references are reduced to 768 px on their long side. BF16 (about 14.2 GB) or INT8 transformer. Qwen Research License: non-commercial research/evaluation only; commercial use requires a separate license from Qwen. Viggle Turbo LoRAs do not apply to this checkpoint.
